summary: Absci Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of 13,495,277 shares of common stock at $7.41 per share, expected to close June 25, 2026. The offering is a standard shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration statement, not a special situation. Net proceeds of ~$93.5 million will fund ABS-201 development and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a distressed or transformative event.
